warnings.message: Claude Code's sandbox on Linux ignores glob patterns in Edit rules too: forbid write **/.git/hooks/** binds the Edit and Write tools, not a sandboxed command there; list the paths it means to protect by name

Claude Code's sandbox on Linux ignores glob patterns, and no literal path covers **/.env; **/secrets/**: sandboxed commands there can read a file these name. The Read tool's deny holds; the forbid guard denies a shell command that names such a path, and listing the files by path in deny_read makes the sandbox hold them

accepted.message: WebFetch outside allow_domains runs unasked under bypassPermissions; the sandbox allowlist binds shell commands only (forbid {tool: web-fetch} removes the fetch tool instead)
accepted.reason: WebFetch under bypass reaches unlisted domains; the devbox's network ACL is the egress boundary

notes: bypass tier devbox requires: prod-unreachable-from-this-host, non-root-container (promptbook check-requires probes each on the host; promptbook run refuses the profile's runs until they pass)
